name: wifi_softap
description: wifi/getting_started/softAP and station on two boards, both as they ship: the access point starts on channel 1 as a 40 MHz BSS (the RF PLL at the centre, its frames on the primary channel), WPA2/WPA3 with SAE, whose elliptic-curve arithmetic runs on the RSA accelerator, and serves DHCP; the station, which starts first, finds nothing in its first scans, then authenticates by SAE, associates, runs the 4-way handshake, its data frames encrypted under the key entries the driver names, and leases 192.168.4.2.

expect.contains: esp_netif_lwip: DHCP server started on interface WIFI_AP_DEF with IP: 192.168.4.1
wifi softAP: wifi_init_softap finished. SSID:myssid password:mypassword channel:1
esp_netif_lwip: DHCP server assigned IP to a client, IP is: 192.168.4.2
wifi:connected with myssid, aid = 1, channel 1, 40U, bssid = 7c:df:a1:45:6d:63
wifi station: connected to ap SSID:myssid password:mypassword
